images.title: Astronaut Edwin Aldrin after deployment of EASEP on surface of moon (AS11-40-5948)
images.alt: Buzz Aldrin stands on the Moon next to a quake sensor, with the laser mirror panel just behind it and the lunar lander far away.

images.title: A Stark Beauty All Its Own (LROC M175124932R)
images.alt: A view from space of Tranquility Base, with labels for the lander, the laser mirror panel and the dark paths the astronauts walked.

images.title: Astronaut David Scott on slope of Hadley Delta during Apollo 15 EVA (AS15-85-11451)
images.alt: An astronaut works at the Moon rover, parked at the edge of a deep, winding valley called Hadley Rille.

images.title: Retracing the Steps of Apollo 15 (PIA13058)
images.alt: A view from space of the edge of Hadley Rille. Labels mark the spots where the crew stopped, and faint rover tracks run between two of them.

images.title: Looking Back on a Golden Opportunity (PIA22928)
images.alt: Opportunity looks back at its own two wheel tracks, stretching across wavy Martian sand to the far edge of the land.

images.title: "Berries" on the Ground (PIA05273)
images.alt: A very close look at small round pebbles called blueberries, sitting in the Martian soil.

images.title: Ingenuity's First Black-and-White Image From the Air (PIA24584)
images.alt: Ingenuity took this picture of its own shadow on the ground while it hovered over Mars on its first flight.

images.title: Ingenuity at 'Valinor Hills' (PIA26237, detail)
images.alt: Ingenuity stands alone as a tiny speck among wavy sand ripples on Mars, at the spot where it made its last flight.

images.title: Mementos of Earth (PIA17035)
images.alt: A worker holds a small flag in front of the Voyager 2 spacecraft, with the shiny Golden Record and its cover on the table below.

images.title: Astronaut Charles Conrad Jr. examines the Surveyor 3 spacecraft (AS12-48-7136)
images.alt: Astronaut Pete Conrad stands beside Surveyor 3 on the Moon. The Apollo 12 lander sits on the hill behind them.

images.title: Sojourner Rover Near The Dice (PIA01122)
images.alt: Sojourner, a small six-wheeled rover with a flat solar panel on top, sits among red rocks on Mars.

images.title: First Photograph Taken on Mars Surface (PIA00381)
images.alt: The first photo taken on the ground on Mars: rocks and sand, with one of Viking 1's footpads at the right.

images.title: Spirit Self-Portrait, Sols 329-330 (PIA07371)
images.alt: Spirit's self-portrait, looking down at its own dusty solar panels on the red ground of Mars.

images.title: InSight's Final Selfie (PIA25287)
images.alt: InSight's last selfie: the lander and its two round solar panels, covered in red dust.

images.title: Close-up of the Apollo 14 laser ranging retroreflector (AS14-67-9386)
images.alt: The Apollo 14 mirror panel, a tilted box full of small round mirrors, on the gray Moon with bootprints around it.

images.title: The Apollo 12 and Surveyor 3 landing site, seen by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter in 2010
images.alt: A view from space of the Apollo 12 site. The lander is a small dark dot near the middle, with thin dark paths where the astronauts walked. Surveyor 3 is a tiny dot in the big round crater to the lower right.
